notes.title: V1.1.0.136 - Gameplay changes | Deck builder update | New AI and UI
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822606/9ceba4e5f8d7084ea85617cad515b9f068345395.png[/img]

[h1]MAJOR UPDATE[/h1]

[b][h3]Update V1.1.0.136
[/h3][/b]
Hey folks! It’s been a long time coming, but here’s our latest mega update for Warmonium. We have been feverishly working away to make Warmonium full release ready, and going forward expect to see regular updates as we ramp up towards the end of the year. 

This update is jam packed with bug fixes, gameplay and AI improvements, plus several QoL changes:

[b][h3]Gameplay changes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] New pathfinding system: increased speed and accuracy.
[*] New ability system: glitches and bugs from abilities have been removed. This new system will allow you to make your own character abilities in the coming updates!
[*] New game mode added: Capture the Flag.
[*] Tutorial has been added to the game.
[/list]

[b][h3]Deck builder changes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] There are now 20 available characters to choose from in the deck builder. All new and existing characters have been reworked with the new ability system.
[*] New characters to look out for:
[*] Hellbringers of Kenvarda
[*] Soulwreath
[*] Woodland Watch
[/list]

[b][h3]AI changes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] New AI controller (currently only EASY-mode AI is available).
[*] Removed lag from AI.
[*] The AI can now control 16 new characters!
[/list]

[b][h3]UI changes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] New main menu UI.
[*] New in-game UI.
[/list]

Big thanks to our playtesters for their work so far in helping improve the game!

[b][h3]Known Bugs[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Reminder that this is in still early access, there will be bugs. Please report any bugs you find with the bug reporter. However, these are the known bugs you won't need to report:
[*] AI freezes occasionally.
[*] Knockback can cause a game crash when used on specific custom maps.
[*] Not all models have animations/sound yet, so some actions will happen with no animation/sound.
[*] Currently large custom maps will lag when saving/loading/creating (new map editor update coming in the next few months).
[*] Map editor CTRL+Z can crash the game sometimes.
[*] Spectate is currently causing a game crash.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42822606/26a119f64d90cf9b95cd4392708daff10ac61207.png[/img]

notes.title: V1.1.0.5 - 2v2 Real Time Strategy Launch
notes.content:
[h2]Warmonium Patch Notes - Version 1.1.0.5[/h2]

Todays update features a major update that brings a new way to play with more players in the lobby.
In version 1.1.0.5, we're introducing a brand-new multiplayer experience and real-time strategy combat. 

[h3]New Features:[/h3]

[b]Multiplayer Lobby - Up to 4 Players:[/b]

Prepare for an intensified tactical experience as you team up with friends or other players in our new multiplayer lobby, demanding coordinated strategy and lightning-fast decision-making.

[b]Real-Time Strategy Combat:[/b]

Work together with your team in synchronous gameplay, reacting to enemy moves, coordinating attacks, and adapting your strategy on the fly.

Each player in your team takes actions simultaneously. Plan your moves, coordinate attacks, and execute strategies with your allies in real time. Communication and teamwork are your keys to victory.

[b]New Map Editor Environments:[/b]

Try the new environment and prefab tile placement. Please report all bugs as this new feature is unstable.
 
[b]Upcoming Balancing and Bug fixes:[/b]

Balance: Foretian - Active Ability: Ensnare [b]Cooldown 1 turn > Now 2 turns[/b]
Bug: Warvisor - Active Ability: Stun Grenade [b]Coolodown is broken causing instability[/b]

We are working hard to complete the list of known bugs addressing various bugs and issues reported by the community, including crashes, visual glitches, and performance optimizations.

[b]Voice Chat Integration coming soon![/b]

notes.title: V1.1.0.2 - Quality of life | BUG FIX
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes for Warmonium V1.1.0.2:[/h1]


Fixed a critical issue where using Tidal Whip with Vetalia Warden would cause a fatal error crash, resulting in game instability and unexpected exits.

The crash has been resolved, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience for all players.
Thanks to your immediate reports and feedback we were able to fix this issue immediately.

notes.title: V1.1.0.1 - Quality of life | BUG FIXES & BALANCE
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes for Warmonium V1.1.0.1:[/h1]

We would like to express our sincere gratitude for your valuable bug reports and feedback, which have been instrumental in improving Warmonium. We also want to apologize for any inconvenience caused by the latest bugs and assure you that we are actively working to address them. Your support and patience are greatly appreciated as we strive to provide you with the best gaming experience possible!

[h2]Game Mechanics:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Implemented -1 hp per turn for summoned units (status effect).[/b]
[/list]

Let's talk about this real quick. It is no longer viable to summon a Necronal Blade with Thearc Elementae each turn if you are far from the enemy. The strategy of champions that summon units now relies on being aggressive now punishing a poorly timed summon.

[list]
[*] Implemented time elapsed for AI horde minigame including save and load.
[*] Added placeholder squad count slider bar and details button (UI update coming next week).
[*] Added average damage to 1v1 end screen.
[*] Fixed ability cooldown bug. ːsteamthumbsupː
[*] Implemented AI range check and health threshold for target unit formula.
[*] Implemented AI health threshold to target unit formula.
[/list]

[b]Daxious Stronghold Towers:[/b]

[list]
[*] Implemented functionality for changing abilities runtime.
[*] Fixed towers health bar update on upgrade defensive for client.
[*] Fixed towers levels not updating on client.
[*] Implemented tower's attack and upgrade utility ability level visuals.
[*] Fixed spam activating tower abilities.
[*] Fixed tower abilities activating against attack.
[/list]

Tower rework is in progress, Daxious Stronghold is being overhauled.

[h2]UI and Graphics:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed lobby duplicates, spectator mode player colors, and lobby text display.
[*] Fixed various UI tooltips and alignment issues.
[*] Updated lobby colors and in-game colors.
[*] Updated game icon.
[*] Modified hover tooltips in the level editor.
[*] Modified examine panel tooltips.
[*] Updated loading screen artwork.
[*] Added new color picker.
[*] Added lite blue color for color picker.
[*] Fixed missing Pillars in Mt Warmon.
[*] Fixed fog culling issues in the Glowing Swamps environment.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs and Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed crystals not spawning in correct order.
[*] Fixed various bugs and issues related to AI behavior, stats, abilities, units, and gameplay.
[*] Fixed various bugs and issues related to spectator mode, reports, health bars, tooltips, and animations.
[*] Fixed various bugs and issues related to abilities, status effects, placements, towers, and character abilities.
[*] Fixed various bugs and issues related to AI behavior and reports.
[/list]

It's notable in this current build that lavarock minions are still very strong and will be receiving an update to their base statistics next week.

notes.title: V1.1.0.0 - New features & Game modes | AI COMBAT | 4 NEW CHARACTERS | SPECTATE
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes for Warmonium V1.1.0.0:[/h1]

We are thrilled to announce the launch of AI game modes in Warmonium. Prepare to test your skills and strategies against the toughest opponents yet.
Test your custom maps or practice your deck strategies on the "Training Grounds". Simply choose your map and deck to begin.

For those who seek an even greater challenge, try Horde mode. Here, you will face waves of AI enemies that will push your skills to the limit. With each wave, the enemies get tougher, so be prepared for a battle of strategic thinking!

Some of the significant changes this week include the implementation of statistics backend for damage dealt and received, the addition of the level editor biome data section, the introduction of a spectator's ability to join a session and improvement in AI stability. 

[h2]Complete list of changes from previous build (V1.0.3.2):[/h2]

[h1]New Characters:[/h1]
The following characters have been unlocked in the deck builder:

[h3][b]Daxious Stronghold [/b][/h3]

notes.title: Patch logs: 1.0.3.2
notes.content:
[b]Patch notes for Warmonium V1.0.3.2:[/b]

While we were hoping to announce single player AI today, unfortunately we are still wrapping up some newly discovered game breaking errors. 

This patch log consists of various updates and bug fixes. The updates include improvements to the game's UI, endgame screen, and performance optimisation. 

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

•   Fixed inventory selection UI parallax card movement
•   Showed full names of items
•   Fixed coming soon text glitch for random characters when clicking "view in deck" button in emporium
•   Disabled "view in deck" button for characters not ready to display
•   Fixed sound volume issues for more balanced audio
•   Fixed malfunctioned units kill count bug
•   Fixed abilities tutorial bugs preventing you from completing the tutorial
•   Fixed the volume issue for Enchanted barb sound effect
•   Fixed the issue of ability warning messages while AI units are in control (such as cancelled summon)
•   Fixed stun grenade (now deactivates ability)
•   Fixed the bug where deactivated ability would not activate again
•   Resolved initiative roll overlapping with landscape issue
•   Fixed Bismuth Warshield particle effect not always showing during attack
•   Fixed lava flickering in all maps and added ember FX to major lava bodies

[b]New Features:[/b]

•   Added initiative dice roll with Realtime physics
•   Reworked endgame screen for single player
•   Added round finish UI
•   Created single player main classes
•   Updated Skirmish menu UI
•   Added camera transition for skirmish scenery
•   Connected Horde game with the new skirmish UI
•   Improved UI to save and load maps
•   Finished classic game mode, which uses a separate controller with squad force settings
•   Added champions and squad figures killed statistics
•   Obtained damage types from receive attack function
•   Made each tutorial part individually reachable in settings menu
•   Improved unit data section in deck builder/ Emporium detailed view
•   Made minor colour changes to Skirmish menu UI

[b]Map Changes:[/b]

•   Removed Ancient Ruins from the official list of maps
•   Revised the Mystic Earth map particle effects
•   mproved environment for Ralmane and Mt. Warmon
•   Added castle structures to Mt. Warmon
•   Removed Horde map from official maps in the lobby

[b]AI Improvements:[/b]  *Alpha access only -  Public release coming soon

•   Implemented new AI behaviours to Thearc movement choice
•   Fixed issue with giving control between AI units causing game state crash
•   Added range attack to AI behaviour tree
•   Implemented AI blade behavior
•   Improved Thearc behavior tree to make more clever decisions with using all abilities
•   Improved AI navigation task
•   Improved the behaviour tree for Necronal Blades
•   Improved safe path and trace back
•   Continued work on AI safe path and pathfinding
•   Fixed giving turn back to the player from AI only when AI used all available units
•   Fixed AI animate bones game state crash
•   Fixed bug where AI units could attack smokescreen units
•   Fixed AI unit line of site calculation incorrectly targeting units through walls
•   Fixed stacking issue on end turn with AI game mode
•   Fixed bugs related to Thornwall and fearful aura with AI game mode
•   Fixed max control limit for AI units
•   Added blade sacrifice ability as AI

notes.title: Patch logs: 1.0.3.1
notes.content:
Version 1.0.3.1 Patch notes:

The Warmonium development team have been hard at work ironing out bugs, implementing new features, working on AI behaviours and improving user interface elements. Some specific tasks included developing Horde game mode, implementing fixed camera locations for tutorial steps, tutorial bugs, improving AI behaviour tree experiments and fixing various AI ability bugs such as the stun grenade and detonate stalls.

Other improvements included working on sound volume fixes, the single player main classes, the endgame screen for single player rework and some UI improvements.

Today a quick fix for the map editor has been pushed. There was an issue with the map save data preventing players from saving, downloading and loading maps.


•   Complete overhaul of world meshes on Mystic Earth, Ralmane, Rocky Grounds and Fight Pit
•   Fixed issue with tutorial where it would load your previous map instead of Mystic Earth.
•   Fixed Woodland Watch hands in Blender - made a new idle animation
•   Improved particles for figures within Emporium 
•   Fixed ability description texts in deck builder
•   Singleplayer main classes made, AI blade behaviour now at rudimentary level
•   Horde game mode developed
•   Endgame screen for singleplayer rework now implemented
•   Added Round finish UI
•   AI Blades will now use the active ability  Sacrifice when Thearc is less than 50% health
•   AI Blades will now use Torment
•   AI Thearc will now use Animate Bones
•   AI Thearc will now use Enchanted Inspiration
•   AI Thearc will now use darkness within
•   Improved control flow between AI units
•   Improved Thearc behaviour tree to make better decisions with using all abilities
•   Fixed ability warning messages while AI units are in control (such as cancelled summon)
•   AI Thearc will now prefer non water tiles if available when using Animate Bones
•   AI Thearc will no longer target lava tiles when using Animate Bones
•   Improved behaviour tree of AI navigation task
•   Implemented Main menu camera movement
•   Enchanted barb SFX volume issue fixed
•   Game finish by timer result changed to draw
•   Random AI end turns have been fixed (probably not.. We can hope though)
•   Made a dispatcher for abilities to finish execute, instead of using a delay
•   Fixed bug where AI units could attack invisible units
•   Fixed a bug faced where AI unit was attacking through wall, added LoS check to prevent this
•   Improved tutorial voice over timing
•   Figures and dice now spin within the Emporium
•   Improved scroll bar UI - Increased thickness 100%
•   Parallax card movement with mouse cursor is being tested and rolled out
•   Fixed camera locations for tutorial steps

Next week we'll see a huge change to the game with the removal of SQUAD FORCE mechanic from the base game mode.
Squad Force will be moved to its own game mode called - Classic. 🤯 More info will be available in next weeks patch log so stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch logs: 1.0.2
notes.content:
Version 1.0.2 Patch notes:

Warmonium has seen various bug fixes and general quality of life updates this week. Our team has worked on the redeemable PAX code and changed the way in game items behave. We have also created a new, immersive main menu, along with fixing known main menu bugs. This week we also saw a rework of the game report (on the left of the screen during gameplay). 

We have also reworked the emporium UI, added new UI elements, and improved the inventory item selection window. We have restored the in game bug reporter, which had stopped working. 
We have so many more changes,  too many to highly detail, so please view the list below of all changes that have happened this week:

•    Fixed alpha coupon code redeem feature and changed item policy settings
•    Fixed new main menu UI switch bugs
•    Created a new passive template and added it to some abilities
•    Implemented expandable stats to active abilities
•    Fixed bug where units were taking fall damage on knockback
•    Reworked the incredible reflex feature
•    Fixed the issue where all enemy units were invisible during the initiative phase
•    Reworked the emporium UI
•    Added new UI elements and improved the inventory item selection window
•    Restored email sending system and made improvements to the emporium marketplace UI
•    Added new images to the cards and implemented the skin equip feature through the inventory item selection window
•    Fixed bugs related to report logs, win image replication, inventory issues, and key mappings
•    Made visual improvements to the report log
•    Fixed bugs related to the stalactite release and gatling rail input area
•    Fixed volcano removed from volcanic pressure
•    Fixed heavy weight report
•    Added attacker name to the combat report
•    Now the report log comes automatically expanded and a button added that you can either collapse/expand all
•    Fixed mouse scroll affecting camera while scrolling report
•    Fixed Dice skin equip bug on emporium
•    Made dice roll cinematic clip on initiate phase and UI modifications
•    Added player equipped dice skin mesh to cinematic clip dices

notes.title: Patch logs: 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We are a week away from early access launch, that's pretty exciting! Here is a list of our recent updates and what we've changed in Warmonium this week:

Version 1.0.1 Patch notes:

•    Combat Report display hotfix
•    Dranic now takes damage after teleport when landing on lava
•    Fixed double lava damage on end turn for clients
•    Fixed no lava damage if it's the enemy's end turn
•    Fixed double drum sound on end turn
•    Improved AI player handling in Singleplayer Mode
•    Fixed bugs related to healing spells and added more intelligent decision making for casting them
•    Implemented AI ability cooldown function and AI ignore malfunctioning unit function
•    Improved AI turn passing to the next AI
•    Updated the combat report log
•    Fixed Daxious not being able to build spear barricade tower
•    Fixed Molten skin from some perspectives
•    Fixed Hefildr size to fit max hovering tile
•    Sheoak, Daxious, and Bismuth units have been locked
•    Unlocked units now appear at the top of the list in the deck
•    AI units now spawn in the team area randomly
•    Fixed AI falling damage issue
•    Towers now spawn in the team area randomly
•    Fixed client issue for new active ability reports
•    Created and categorized core report types
•    Implemented rank data and report type to each report UI that requests to be reported in the report list, allowing all reports to be stored and reported at once in spawning order
•    Fixed bug with examine page where status effects were not updating correctly
•    Face cam and stats no longer grey out if it's not the player's turn
•    Clamped stats to zero to prevent showing negative values
•    Fixed sound volume for turn sound, reload voice, unit selection, and button clicks
•    Added Steam achievements
•    Modified Dice roll UI
•    Learned how to change tile meshes
•    Worked on new report system; got all stacked reports sorted by their ranks and ready to report anytime with correct order
•    Report page no longer automatically scrolls down if it's not already at the bottom
•    Report page now opens on game start
•    Saved map size when custom map creates automatically
•    Loaded map size in server browser
•    When clicking on a session, an extra information section will now be expanded
•    Modified match end screen to include biggest hit, biggest defense, figures controlled, and tiles moved
•    Added map Mystic Earth
•    Redesigned a scenery (WIP)
•    Fixed smoke screen so that it only affects the unit activating it
•    Added Bismuth back to the game
•    Worked on lavarock minions animations/particles and sounds
•    Fixed attack all issue for lavarock minions
•    Clamped bottom examine box stats to zero
•    Now Unstable rift costs -1 hitpoints
•    Fixed ranged attack issue for animate spear when adjacent
•    Added selection particle for Hefildr and lavarock minions units


Please note that singleplayer / AI function is not yet available, we're working hard on this we promise :)

notes.title: One does not simply launch Warmonium... Patch logs: 1.0.0
notes.content:
Dear community,

We want to apologize for the delay in the early access launch of our game. While we had hoped to release the game on Steam earlier, we encountered several build errors that needed to be addressed before we could proceed. We have since re-uploaded the game and have been approved for publishing, but there are still a few remaining game breaking bugs that need to be fixed before we can launch.

We know how excited you all are to play the game and we share that excitement, but we also want to ensure that your experience is the best it can be. Therefore, we have made the difficult decision to delay the launch until we can fix these major issues. We expect to have them resolved by the end of January.

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to the incredible Alpha Crew who have supported us and provided valuable feedback during the testing phase. The Alpha build will continue to be available for those interested in experimenting with game mechanics and features.

We have been working hard to fix numerous game breaking bugs and have a long list of known minor bugs that we are continuing to address. Here is a list of everything we have fixed this month:

[b]December 16th - 22nd[/b]

- Carnal now activates on placement after the match start
- Knockback is no longer possible on invisible units
- The Warshield report has been added
- The examine menu now shows cooldowns for both players
- Tidal whip now damages teammates as well
- The combat log for Stunforce now correctly displays -1 attack
- Downhill momentum now correctly displays 1 damage in the combat report
- Projectile Pavise no longer hits units without line of sight
- Momentous boulder now correctly applies to only one unit when attacking
- Tower limit now works correctly for Daxious
- Line of sight through volcano has been fixed
- Spear barricade no longer hurts TMT (gatling rail) units
- Sacrifice now only restores 5 HP or 5% of maximum HP (previously could restore 0 HP)
- Blade's disease debuff no longer persists after the unit is defeated
- The safe path toggle now works for all players
- integrity now activates correctly after leaving adjacent terrain
- Dranic no longer gains war shield when teleporting next to Bismuth
- War shield is now removed when teleporting (Dranic no longer gains war shield after teleport)
- War shield now activates on placement after game start
- Bismuth's war shield no longer persists after the unit is defeated
- Bismuth's war shield no longer disappears on the first move
- When someone leaves the lobby and rejoins, the match state is now reset
- Dranic spawn sound has been fixed
- A 10 second timer has been added
- An endgame screen with in-match statistics has been added
- Ability text has been formalized to a standard across in game UI
- Each new player now starts with 4 dice
- Loading screen music has been changed
- Damage dealt has been added to statistics
- The map editor now correctly displays valid spawn tiles in green
- Custom game wins have been added to statistics

[b]December 8th - 15th[/b]

- Unit health is now restored from the previous session when reloading a session
- If a squad unit uses an ability and the unit is changed quickly, the ability will no longer be used by the new unit
- The PAX Thearc Skin promotional item has been updated
- The option to quit to the main menu has been renamed to "Rage Quit"
- When a client rejoins a session, they can now see host figures
- The bug with Smoke Screen and sentry tower has been fixed
- More details and access to session reload UI's have been added
- Custom maps played are now tracked in statistics
- When a player is kicked from the lobby, their name is now removed from the player list
- The leaderboard now shows the player's rank
- The leaderboard no longer duplicates values when it refreshes
- When a player leaves a game from the lobby, the lobby player list now updates correctly
- Notification text now displays the correct stat and value rather than "unknown"
- The examine text for Projectile Pavise now correctly displays the towers defence value
- Examine has been fixed and now displays the correct information and status effects
- Major Gamestate breaking failure 4 causing game disconnections has been fixed
- The game time stat and leaderboard now work correctly
- Squad force now works correctly
- Height check for disease has been implemented
- Stable Shift cooldown has been set to 2
- Stench has been fixed
- Warvisor animation at 0 HP has been fixed
- Format Magma has been corrected and is now ability #1
- Hotkey 4 has been removed
- Phyto now activates on placement and end turn
- Hefildir's Magma ability now displays the correct text on unavailable tiles
- The client now correctly displays the Tidal Whip report
- Vetalia can now correctly heal herself with Restore Essence
- Earthshake now includes camera shake
- Momentous boulder now correctly only applies status effects, not damage
- Momentous boulder now correctly applies the intended status effect
- The Sheoak visibility bug has been fixed
- Disease now correctly applies and displays text on blade movement
- Disease issues have been resolved
- The Phyto bug causing incorrect movement when leaving grass/jungle has been fixed
- The game no longer breaks when trying to build a tower on the server
- Duplicate item purchases are no longer possible by pressing the purchase button twice
- Players can no longer join full games
- A 10 second timer has been added after placement but before the game start
- The cancel ability now works correctly
- Placing two Projectile Pavise units from different teams on the same turn no longer breaks the game
- Health bar focus is now correctly displayed for multi-target attacks
- Spear barricade now correctly rolls defence against ranged attacks
- Projectile Pavise no longer appears in the combat log if it has no units in range
- Warvisor now has a death animation for its second death
- Mythic line of sight has been checked and fixed as necessary
- Ability texts have been updated
- A blank textbox no longer appears when using Sacrifice with no Morph Champion
- The Tidal Whip report has been improved
- Restore Essence now correctly heals the user when clicked on an empty tile
- Scathing Blade now correctly costs 4 HP to use
- Conical Flail has been fixed for issues with animation, mechanics, and report
- Infinite walk animation after falling can now be ended, and this has been checked for Aboth as well
- Mechabots now correctly have their health restored after the field mechanic
- The Projectile Pavise report has been improved and is no longer confusing
- Team markers have been removed from buildings and now only show on units
- The line of sight check for Projectile Pavise has been fixed
- Momentous Boulder is no longer piercing
- Momentous Boulder and War Shield now correctly activate when hit by Projectile Pavise
- Detonate now correctly rolls the correct amount of calculated damage
- The cooldown for Conical Flail has been fixed
- Detonate now correctly affects all adjacent units
- The damage report for Piercing Arrow has been improved
- The War Shield report now correctly displays information
- The War Shield report now correctly states that it provides +2 defense (not +4)
- Overswing now correctly has a 5% chance to give Bismuth -5 HP
- The authentication process has been filtered and players now have access to play the game as soon as possible
- Projectile Pavise damage issues have been fixed
- The Emporium main page has been redesigned with improved user interface design and functionalities


[b]December 1st - 7th[/b]

- Pathfinding issues were fixed after a unit died by disengagement.
- Call Thunder was causing multiple instances of damage, but this issue has been fixed
- Ghost units that would be damaged by "call thunder" were appearing during placement, but this issue has been resolved.
- Commander Sheoaks active abilities were consuming the normal attack, this issue has been fixed
- The "play" button was removed from the main menu deck builder.
- The "play" button was removed from the war scroll after it was opened from the map editor and then closed
- The "your turn" banner sometimes displayed the wrong colour when a turn started, but this issue has been fixed
- The "play" button was removed from the Deck Builder.
Fall damage was bundling together when a unit took fall damage onto a lava tile, but this issue has been fixed
- The morph sound and particle were activating when a unit moved through an invisible unit, but this issue has been resolved.
- Failure 5 has been fixed.
- The bounty report was checked and fixed
- The tidal whip ability was causing damage to the "Dranic" unit three times, but this issue has been fixed.
- Call Thunder was causing multiple instances of damage, but this issue has been fixed.
- Projectile Pavise was causing damage between gaps (this was also tested with height differences)
- There was an issue with client damage caused by the Projectile Pavise ability, but this issue has been resolved
- Animate Spear was causing the incredible reflex passive ability to activate
- Earthshake was not stacking as intended, but this issue has been resolved.
- The "pathfinding safe path toggle true" feature was not working as intended.
- Vetalia can now move with 0 movement points on water.
- The new health bar for malfunction was not functioning properly.
- The scroll box for card placement was lowered.
- A new navigation method for the safe path feature was implemented.
- The speed of the Integrity particle effect was decreased by 200%.
- The "bounty" ability was playing its animation even when it was not being activated.
- The death sound for the Dranic unit was fixed.
- The sound for Conical Flail ability was fixed
- The sound for Call Thunder ability was fixed.
- The text for when a tower could not be built was changed to "cannot build there."
- The text for invalid unit selections for abilities that can be used on all units was changed.
- Bounty was made to work for all players.
- The issue with units floating when selecting them was fixed.
- The sheoak unit was fixed.
- The damage for Curve Shot and Piercing Arrow was fixed.
- Phyto was increased by 1 for each turn.
- The "fix markers" feature was made to only show for a player's team.
- Restore Essence height check was restored.

We also have a list of known bugs so far that we will tackle in Q1 2023:
- ABOTH: Momentous boulder applies to random opponent figures after attacking
- BISMUTH: Conical Flail animation does not play after activation intermittently on client side
- BISMUTH: Knockback works on invisible units
- BISMUTH: Particle effects of all active and passive abilities to be updated to improve visual feedback
- BLADES: Graphical glitch causing Disease passive to reset and proc each turn
- BLADES: Stench status effect is not updating correctly on client and host
- CAMERA: Incorrectly calculating the live position of face camera when switching between figures
- CARNAL: Particle effects to be updated to improve visual feedback
- DAXIOUS:  Projectile Pavise Incorrectly displaying combat dice rolls in combat log
- DAXIOUS: Intermittent issue with Integrity not activating during the game
- DAXIOUS: Limit on buildings not activating
- FOG OF WAR: Intermittent issue revealing your placement to your enemy before placement phase has ended
- HEFILDR: Stalactite release is not targeting adjacent figures
- HEFILDR: The volcano from volcanic pressure blocks movement and the smoke will block LOS
- HUKATO: SFX require overhaul with miss matched sounds and missing queues
- HUKATO: While moving there is a noticeable amount of dropped frames
- LAVAROCK: Using attack all feature incorrectly calculates the correct damage
- PATHFINDING: Intermittent movement issue with experimental safe path, global block on all figure movement
- PHYTO: Movement buff removes itself after moving off of Grass / Jungle biome
- SELECTION: Intermittent bug when turn timer set to 10 seconds with 5 minute game timer
- SERVER: If you disconnect from a P2P session the game will end. We are working on a saved game state and the mechanic to re-connect!
- SFX:  Figure SFX may still play even when the game sounds are muted
- SFX:  SFX may be much louder than intended intermittently
- SHEOAK: Intermittent visibility issue after placement
- SHEOAK: SFX require overhaul with miss matched sounds and missing queues
- TMT: Gatling Rail is broken and not calculating LOS properly
- TMT: When shooting a Projectile Pavise with range there is no attack animation or projectile
- TMT: Intermittent issue projectile shoots at 0.01% speed 
- VETALIA: Intermittent issue with Tidal Whip not damaging all enemies
- VETALIA: While moving across water there is a noticeable amount of dropped frames
- WARVISOR:  Intermittent Issue with smokescreen and sentry towers. Warvisors stay invisible the turn smokescreen is activated.

Thank you for your patience and support. We can't wait for you to join us in the early access launch of Warmonium!

Sincerely,
Team WAR

notes.title: Early access imminent - Countdown begins!
notes.content:
First off a huge thank you to our Alpha crew who have helped us shape the game so much over the past few months. Another thank you to everyone who visited and playtested Warmonium at AUS PAX 2022!

We have been hard at work creating and implementing mechanics/UI to improve the player experience.
The developers are currently working on ranked matchmaking, over 125 abilities for new champions/squads, animations, SFX/VFX and world meshes for the map editor! 

Within the next 45 days we will be publishing our early access build for purchase on steam store.
Join the development journey of Warmonium and help us shape the future of online turn based tactics!

Early access will be available at a 50% discount compared to the full game release price.

Warmonium will stay in Early access until all features have been implemented within our road map. 

The price listed on the store page will be updated to full price once Warmonium is ready for launch.
On launch there will be a 25% discount compared to full game price for [strike]1 month[/strike]* 1 week.*

Our in-store marketplace will only offer cosmetic items and account upgrades. 
All content is accessible and nothing in the store will provide strategic advantage!

For more information check out our discord channel and wiki available at:
